Counsel for Applicant :- Vyas Narayan Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0132 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B, 34 IPC & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Jagatpur, District Rae Bareli.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant one year ago after he had enticed her away and thereafter, the matrimonial family used to harass her.
It was stated that the entire matrimonial family had killed her.
The postmortem report on record indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other injury was observed on the body of the deceased.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 1 5. Considering the postmortem report on record and the fact that the marriage was a love marriage and there being no material to demonstrate that the applicant who is mother-in-law had harassed the victim soon before her death in relation to demand of dowry either physically or mentally, as such, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Phoolmati be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
